name: bug-triage
description: Triage a new bug report: severity, owner, and a reproducible summary. Use when someone pastes a bug report or asks to triage an issue.

name: customer-call-notes
description: Turn raw customer call notes into a structured summary with pains, requests, and follow-ups. Use after any customer or sales call.

name: incident-postmortem
description: Write a blameless incident postmortem with timeline, impact, root cause, and action items. Use after an outage or incident.

name: onboarding-checklist
description: Build a first-week onboarding checklist for a new hire by role. Use when someone new joins the team.

name: meeting-agenda
description: Draft a meeting agenda with goals, topics, owners, and timeboxes. Use before any recurring or ad hoc meeting.

name: okr-draft
description: Draft quarterly OKRs with measurable key results. Use when planning a quarter or reviewing goals.

name: hiring-scorecard
description: Write an interview scorecard for a role with competencies and rating anchors. Use when opening a role or preparing interviews.

name: candidate-debrief
description: Summarize interview feedback into a hire or no-hire recommendation. Use after an interview loop.

name: sales-followup-email
description: Draft a follow-up email after a sales call with next steps. Use after a prospect call.

name: pricing-faq
description: Answer pricing questions with the approved plan details and limits. Use when a customer asks about pricing or plans.

name: support-macro
description: Write a support reply in the team's tone with troubleshooting steps. Use when answering a customer support ticket.

name: product-spec
description: Write a one-page product spec with problem, users, scope, and success metrics. Use when proposing a new feature.

name: design-review
description: Run a structured design review covering usability, accessibility, and consistency. Use when reviewing a mockup or UI.

name: code-review-checklist
description: Review a pull request for correctness, tests, security, and readability. Use when asked to review code.

name: security-questionnaire
description: Fill in a customer security questionnaire from approved answers. Use when a customer sends a security review.

name: investor-update
description: Write the monthly investor update with metrics, wins, asks. Use at the end of each month for investors.

name: board-deck-outline
description: Outline a board meeting deck. Use when preparing for a board meeting.

name: competitor-brief
description: Summarize a competitor's product, pricing, and positioning. Use when someone asks about a competitor.

name: blog-post-draft
description: Draft a company blog post in the house style. Use when writing a blog post or announcement.

name: social-post
description: Write a short social post announcing a launch. Use when announcing something on X or LinkedIn.

name: retro-facilitation
description: Run a sprint retrospective: what went well, what didn't, actions. Use at the end of a sprint.

name: sprint-planning
description: Plan a sprint from the backlog with capacity and goals. Use at the start of a sprint.

name: data-request
description: Answer an internal data request with the right query and caveats. Use when someone asks for a metric or number.

name: contract-summary
description: Summarize a contract's key terms, renewal dates, and risks. Use when reviewing a contract.

name: user-interview-guide
description: Write a user interview guide with open questions. Use before user research sessions.

name: travel-plan
description: Plan a team offsite or business trip itinerary. Use when someone is organizing travel.
